name: htD_shield_bot_sb1
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/htD_shield_bot_sb1; mkdir -p $O
pip install -q xatlas==0.0.11
[ -f herotripo_in/shield_bot/tripo.glb ] || (cd herotripo_prep && npm install --silent --no-audit --no-fund && node decode.mjs ../herotripo_in/shield_bot/tripo_src.glb ../herotripo_in/shield_bot/tripo.glb)
python3 herotripo_bake.py -- --hero shield_bot --in herotripo_in/shield_bot --out $O > $O/bake.log 2>&1 || (tail -80 $O/bake.log; exit 1)
grep '^.ht.' $O/bake.log | tail -40; rm -f $O/tex_*; ls -la $O
